requirements.text: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing and delivering production systems
Deep experience building and scaling RESTful APIs and integrating with complex backend data sources
Strong proficiency in Python for backend development (FastAPI, Django, or Flask preferred)
Experience with modern frontend frameworks, ideally React, with the ability to contribute when needed
Hands-on experience with Node.js or equivalent runtime environments
Strong SQL skills, including schema design, query optimization, tuning, and partitioning strategies
Experience working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data formats (e.g., JSON, Parquet)
Production experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines and DAG-based orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, etc.)
Practical experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS
Strong understanding of security, compliance, identity, and access management in distributed systems
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
A proactive mindset with the ability to adapt quickly and drive change
Experience building developer-facing platforms or APIs used by external customers
Exposure to high-throughput or low-latency systems at scale
Familiarity with observability tooling (metrics, logging, tracing) in distributed systems
Experience with infrastructure-as-code or deployment automation
Prior experience in startup or high-growth environments

Carbon Arc is headquartered in New York City and operates as a remote-first company. Team members are expected to travel for in-person onsite gatherings at least one week per quarter to collaborate, plan, and connect as a team.
